articles.headline: Yanks' Cole concedes he needs to 'start making adjustments' after dud
articles.description: Yankees right-hander Gerrit Cole, one of the most cerebral pitchers in the majors, could not make the proper adjustments to pitch deeper into Saturday's 12-2 loss to the Mets. Afterward, he said answers eluded him.
articles.headlineJa: 不調に終わった登板後、ヤンキースのコールは「修正を始める」必要があると認める
articles.descriptionJa: メジャー屈指の頭脳派投手であるヤンキースの右腕ゲリット・コールは、12-2で敗れた土曜日のメッツ戦で長い回を投げるための適切な修正を行うことができなかった。試合後、彼は解決策が見つからなかったと語った。

articles.headline: Ranger Suarez goes 7 innings, Wilyer Abreu hits key 2-run double as Red Sox beat Royals 5-1
articles.description: — Ranger Suarez struck out eight in seven innings of one-run ball, Wilyer Abreu hit a tiebreaking two-run double and the Boston Red Sox beat the Kansas City Royals 5-1 on Saturday to halt a three-game skid.

articles.headline: Premier League VAR review: Was Sunderland's penalty legit vs. Arsenal?
